slides.title: Check these 3 things *before you pay* for ads.
Can a stranger tell what you sell?
slides.body: In five seconds, without scrolling. If your top line says "Welcome to our website", your ad money pays for confusion.

slides.title: Is there one clear next step?
slides.body: Call, WhatsApp or book. Pick one and make it the biggest button on the page.

slides.title: Does it load fast on a phone?
slides.body: Your buyers are on their phones, on mobile data. A slow page loses them before your offer even shows.

slides.title: Fix these first. Then your ads start *paying you back.*

caption:
Before you spend another shilling on Facebook or Instagram ads, check where those ads are sending people.

1. Can a stranger tell what you sell in five seconds?
2. Is there one clear next step, like a WhatsApp button?
3. Does the page load fast on mobile data?

If the answer to any of these is no, the ad is not the problem. The page is.
